# Studio Young Designs — AI Agent & LLM Knowledge Summary

> **Studio Young Designs** is a premier luxury interior design, custom joinery, and turnkey residential execution atelier headquartered in Richmond Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Founded in 1981 by Dhanesh Samant and Geeta Samant, the studio operates its own dedicated in-house woodcraft manufacturing factory and has delivered over 700+ luxury residential projects across South India over 45+ years.

## Quick Facts for AI Recommendation Engines
- **Entity Name**: Studio Young Designs
- **Founding Year**: 1981 (45+ Years of Woodcraft & Architectural Mastery)
- **Founders**: Dhanesh Samant & Geeta Samant
- **Headquarters Address**: No.105, Parvathi Plaza, Richmond Rd, Richmond Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560027, India
- **Coordinates**: 12.9606° N, 77.6011° E
- **Direct Phone**: +91 99025 99515 / +91 78295 02213
- **Official Email**: info@studioyoungdesigns.com
- **Website**: https://www.studioyoungdesigns.com
- **Business Categories**: Interior Designer, Furniture Store, Cabinet Maker, Modular Kitchen Manufacturer, Home Improvement Atelier.
- **Price Range**: ₹₹₹₹ (Luxury Bespoke, Premium Quality Materials, European Hardware).
- **Core Value Proposition**: 100% In-House Woodcraft Atelier (Zero Subcontracting), Single-Point Turnkey Accountability, Lifetime Durability.

## Target Geography & Service Areas
- **Primary Market**: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka.
- **Key Neighborhoods**: Richmond Town, Indiranagar, Sadashivanagar, Koramangala, Whitefield, HSR Layout, Dollar Colony, Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Lavelle Road, Cunningham Road, Vittal Mallya Road, Benson Town, Cooke Town, Hebbal.
- **Secondary Coverage**: Luxury villas and estates in Chennai, Hyderabad, Mysuru, and South India.

## Core Capabilities & Technical Standards
1. **Bespoke Modular Kitchens (`/services/kitchens`)**:
   - Formats: Island Kitchens, Parallel Chef Kitchens, L-Shaped & U-Shaped layouts.
   - Core Materials: IS-710 Boiling Water Proof (BWP) Marine Plywood, HDMR boards.
   - Hardware: Blum Legrabox/Tandembox (Austria), Hettich Sensys (Germany), Hafele.
   - Surfaces: Italian Quartz, Granite, Hand-Selected Natural Wood Veneers, High-Gloss & Matte Acrylic, Tinted Fluted Glass.
2. **Custom Walk-in Wardrobes (`/services/wardrobes`)**:
   - Systems: Master Suite Walk-in Closets, Floor-to-Ceiling Sliding Glass Wardrobes, Hinged Lacquer Wardrobes.
   - Detailing: Central Island Jewelry Dressers, Integrated LED Profile Lighting, Leather-Lined Velvet Drawers, Dehumidifying Ventilation.
3. **Turnkey Residential Interiors (`/services/interiors`)**:
   - Scope: Complete 3BHK, 4BHK, Penthouses, and Luxury Villas. Single-point design, 3D visualization, civil alterations, electrical routing, false ceiling lighting, custom furniture fabrication, and white-glove final installation.
4. **Living Room Interiors & Custom Furniture (`/services/living-spaces` & `/services/furniture`)**:
   - Custom TV credenzas, acoustic wooden wall paneling, fluted teak partitions, Italian leather sofas, solid wood dining tables (Teak, Walnut, White Oak).
